about: A daily series at 20:00 New York (at 19:00, 00:00 UTC, since the probe of 2026-11-13 the undone notes leave a record where the two forms meet and the switch is refused on Google, 3.48 and 3.65, which is not this case's subject), a day given notes and the change undone, the series made all-day, other notes given to the same day, then the first notes redone: refused with nothing written here or sent (x-day). The gate comes before staleness: the day had no row and no skip when the series was made all-day, so the refusal is not_undoable, which force does not pass, and the newer notes stand. (The file keeps its name; until the gate the refusal was stale_undo.)
